text:
emily: Alert from channel ops: Channel partner CloudRoute uploaded their Azure marketplace invoice for May (CR-549). They show a large allocation of metered units to account A-998 that we don't have in our tenant mapping. Can partner finance confirm mapping?

diego: Our reseller mapping table has A-998 mapped to partner account CR-549 but with zero activity in May. Their invoice lists 210k units to A-998 and 12k units to A-999. Our raw meter logs show 12k across A-999 only.

vikas: Likely a downstream attribute join bug on partner side: account IDs got swapped during their billing export. Partner-finance, can you confirm whether CR-549 export pipeline applied a join on "customer_alias" incorrectly?

partner-finance: Confirmed. We reproduced the mismatch locally. The export script applied a left join using alias instead of canonical account_id for exports from 2026-05-29 02:10-03:15 UTC. We're preparing a corrected invoice + CM. ETA 5 business days. Apologies.

emily: Thanks. We need to decide accounting treatment for close. If corrected CM arrives after close we should not overstate revenue for account A-998. Recommendation: post a provisional contra-revenue JV for the overstated allocation amount $15,600 (list) and tag as "channel_mapping_error".

diego: Agree. Also tag the JV with a note linking to ticket CH-3344 and include the problematic export window.

billing-bot: Provisional JV created: JV-2026-0580, amount $15,600, GL 4-130, status: PENDING_REVERSAL, ticket: FIN-4625.

vikas: Ops action: partner asked us to avoid customer-facing messages until they send corrected artifacts. We'll add a contingency note in the month-close pack and block invoice recognition for CR-549 until CM received.

emily: Draft partner message (for records):

"Subject: CR-549 Azure marketplace invoice - provisional accounting adjustment

Hi CloudRoute team,

Thanks for the update. We've posted a provisional adjustment (JV-2026-0580) to avoid recognizing overstated usage pending your corrected invoice and credit memo. Please send the corrected invoice and CM referencing CR-549-export-20260529 to billing@redwood.ai. Once received we will reverse the provisional JV and reconcile.

Best,
Emily (Finance)"

partner-finance: We'll send the corrected files and RCA.

emily: Leave thread open until CM attached to ticket FIN-4625.

diego: Adding a follow-up: can infra add a pre-ingest validation that alerts on >200% allocation to a single account vs prior month? I'll file INFRA-7770.

billing-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-7770. Assigned diego.

emily: Thanks all. Will update month-close checklist and revenue hold flags.
